findings.title: Gaza medical sources report four deaths and six injuries received by hospitals in the previous 24 hours; 21 prior deaths added after record validation
findings.affected_population_system: Palestinians killed or injured; Gaza hospital casualty admissions; retrospective death-certificate verification; ambulance and rescue access
findings.exact_supporting_passage: مستشفيات قطاع غزة استقبلت، خلال 24الـ ساعة الماضية، 4 شهداء، و6 مصابين. ... تم إضافة 21 شهيدًا إلى الإحصائية التراكمية
findings.source_type: Palestinian public news agency citing Gaza medical sources
findings.summary: WAFA posted updated cumulative fatalities of 74,699 and injuries of 176,098. It said Gaza hospitals received four dead and six wounded over the previous 24 hours, and 21 earlier deaths were added after records were verified. The 21 additions are historical data adjustments, not 21 new deaths. Incident-level dates, identities and independent confirmation not supplied.

bounded_discovery_context.discovered_via: WAFA Arabic latest-news direct index, then original article, following OCHA OPT and WHO official-first checks
bounded_discovery_context.caveats: The article shows publication 15 November 2026 at 15:19 Palestine time but its body begins 'غزة 14-11-2026', an inconsistent dateline. Treat incidence date as unknown and the fresh publication as a newly available medical statistical update. A potentially overlapping November 14 medical report was not authoritatively verified.
